interpretation: GIST product labels are plant-level commercial descriptions, not CN/TARIC classifications. A mapping identifies a possible legal product family only and never establishes customs scope.

rebar.note: Direct commercial-family wording match. CN/TARIC classification is still required.

tinplate.note: Tinplate is a tin-mill product family candidate; exact CN/TARIC classification is still required.

galvanized.note: Galvanized sheet points to the metallic-coated family but the split product number cannot be resolved from the GIST label.

wire rod.note: The GIST label does not distinguish stainless from non-alloy/other-alloy wire rod.

cold rolled.note: The GIST label does not distinguish stainless from non-alloy/other-alloy cold-rolled products.

plate.note: The GIST label does not distinguish stainless from non-alloy/other-alloy plate.

seamless pipe.note: The GIST label does not distinguish stainless from other seamless tubes/pipes.

hot rolled.note: Hot-rolled is too broad to distinguish sheets/strips from quarto plate or stainless families.

bar.note: Generic bar does not identify merchant bar, rebar, stainless bar or cold-finished bar.

sections.note: Generic sections can refer to light, stainless, structural or hollow sections.

section.note: Generic section can refer to light, stainless, structural or hollow sections.

profile.note: Profile is too broad to identify the applicable legal section family.

profiles.note: Profiles is too broad to identify the applicable legal section family.

pipe.note: Generic pipe does not establish welded/seamless, stainless, gas-pipe or dimensional family.

tube.note: Generic tube does not establish welded/seamless, stainless or dimensional family.

wire.note: The current measure includes non-alloy wire, while stainless wire is separately under product-scope review; the generic GIST label is insufficient.

sheet.note: Generic sheet is too broad across hot/cold rolled, coated, electrical, stainless and tin-mill families.

coil.note: Coil describes form rather than a sufficiently specific legal product family.

billet.note: No defensible current mapping from the GIST billet label to the reviewed measure categories.

slab.note: No defensible current mapping from the GIST slab label to the reviewed measure categories.
